title: Full rest from running + posterior chain / hip strength

steps.target: Z1 mobility, hip flow, ankle and calf, no loaded knee flexion
Z1 side plank with hip abduction, each side
Z1 single-leg glute bridge, each side, slow
Z1 glute med and TFL release, hip flexor stretch

coachNotes: The bike is not with you, so the 40-load aerobic flush is gone and this becomes true rest plus strength. Do not replace it with a run. The reason this was never a running day is the 1206m of descent on Wednesday after a 17-day eccentric gap, and ITB symptoms surface 24-48h after the descent that caused them, which is today and tomorrow. Losing 32 load matters less than it looks: projected CTL still lands at 43 on Sunday, above the 42 race target, 20 days out. STEP-DOWNS ARE DELIBERATELY REMOVED from the usual set. They are the one exercise here that loads the knee eccentrically and today is the wrong day for it, they come back next week in Milan when the legs are on flat ground. Everything left is hip abduction and isometric, which is what actually protects the ITB. THIS IS ALSO THE GATE FOR SATURDAY: log lateral knee feel this morning and tomorrow morning honestly. Clean both days, Saturday goes at 1000m D+. Any lateral tightness, any of that specific band-over-the-condyle ache on stairs, and Saturday reverts to 800m and load 110. Garmin expect 10-20.
